performance.verdict: Leads are structurally dark; spend throttle is deliberate, not the diagnosis.

findings.text: Leads read zero across all 28 days and all 28 series dates — GHL shows 74 contacts and 40 opps, confirming leads are arriving but not flowing into the tracked metric. Attribution is broken, not demand.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event. Speed-to-lead automations are unverified; Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and intake ownership is unconfirmed.

Google spend is erratic: 7 zero-spend days in the last 28 (e.g. 7/29, 7/30, 8/2–8/4, 8/6, 8/9) against active campaign days hitting $248. Throttled budget cap causes daily on/off cycling, not campaign failure.

3-day signal (8/17–8/19): avg daily spend $18.80 vs prior 3 days (8/14–8/16) avg $52.47 — a 64% spend compression. GBP actions also zero for 8/17–8/19 after averaging 3.7/day prior. Short-run momentum is flat/falling.
GHL shows 40 opps created but only 6 won (15% close rate) and 0 appointments logged in 28 days. Zero appointments against 74 contacts signals intake or booking-bot failure, not ad underperformance.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL lead source mapping to identify why 74 contacts and 40 opps show zero in tracked leads metric.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 74 contacts and 40 opportunities created in 28 days, but the leads metric reads zero across the entire series — this is a tracking/source-mapping break, not a demand problem. Nacer or Sohib should confirm which GHL pipeline stage maps to a 'lead' event and whether the Windsor/CRM connector is firing correctly. Success check: leads metric reflects real contact volume within 3 days of fix (by 2026-08-23). Until attribution is repaired, CPL and efficiency scores are meaningless.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake ownership post-Vivian departure and verify booking bot is live; 0 appointments in 28 days confirms the seat is empty or bot is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and intake ownership has not been re-confirmed per the August SOW milestone. GHL shows 0 appointments against 40 opportunities in 28 days — strong signal the booking bot or the human intake seat is non-functional. Action: get Xavier or Aiman to confirm who owns GHL intake today, verify their login is active, and run a test booking through the bot. Success check: at least one test appointment appears in GHL by 2026-08-22, and the overdue battle-test (due 7/31) is completed and documented.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget increases — scale-back-up gate in SOW is uncleared while intake ownership is unresolved. Re-check 2026-08-23.
suggestions.monday_update: The SOW scale-back-up gate explicitly blocks raising budgets until intake is confirmed operational. Google spend is already cycling erratically ($0 on 7 of last 28 days, with single-day highs of $248) due to throttling — adding budget into an unconfirmed intake funnel would waste spend. Re-check on 2026-08-23: if intake ownership is confirmed and GHL attribution is repaired, the budget discussion can open. No action on spend until both gates clear.
